newsitem.title: IRAN: Turkmen president arrives in Iran for gas talks.
newsitem.headline: Turkmen president arrives in Iran for gas talks.

text.p: Turkmenistan's President Saparmurat Niyazov arrived on Wednesday for two days of talks on issues including Turkmen gas exports to Iran.
The official news agency IRNA said Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani welcomed Niyazov and said the two leaders would also discuss neighbouring Afghanistan and Central Asian republics.

The countries have expressed concern at continuing bloodshed in Afghanistan and instability in Tajikistan, whose government agreed last December on a ceasefire with the Islamist opposition after a four-year civil war.

Also under discussion will be a project to transport Turkmen gas to Turkey across Iran by using the existing Iranian pipeline system in addition to an earlier project to build new pipelines, a Turkmen oil and gas official said earlier this week.
The new route for Turkmen gas would run separately from a joint Turkmen-Iranian pipeline currently under construction.
